subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale reasoning from breaking later turns

question: Should Copilot use this PR's process-active reasoning preservation policy, always strip encrypted reasoning as proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95493, or pursue a deeper persisted-lineage and migration design?
rationale: The alternatives trade reasoning continuity against reliability and define different provider/session compatibility contracts; tests cannot establish which contract maintainers want or which Copilot lineage assumptions hold in production.

options.title: Preserve verified active reasoning
options.body: Continue this design after moving activation to observed provider success, consolidating the overlapping drain work, and adding live Copilot lifecycle proof.

options.title: Always strip encrypted reasoning
options.body: Prefer the narrow provider-boundary policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95493, accepting reduced reasoning continuity for simpler reliability.

options.title: Design persisted lineage repair
options.body: Pause the competing PRs and define explicit lineage plus doctor migration for existing poisoned transcripts before implementation.

recommendation.title: Preserve verified active reasoning
recommendation.body: Continue this design after moving activation to observed provider success, consolidating the overlapping drain work, and adding live Copilot lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the shared Responses transport and provider-owned Copilot replay boundary, both areas with substantial adjacent history from this contributor.
